story_judge.scale: 1-5 per dimension; the score is the mean

dimensions.hook: Does the first page give a reason to keep reading?
dimensions.coherence: Do events follow from each other with no unexplained jumps?
dimensions.pacing: Is each beat given the room it needs for the page count?
dimensions.payoff: Does the ending resolve what the opening set up?
dimensions.voice: Could you tell the characters apart with the names hidden?

story_judge.human_panel: Monthly: three readers score 20 sampled comics with the same rubric; report the gap to the LLM judge.

bakeoff.protocol: spec 8.4: 20 scenes, identical references and compiled prompts, 2 samples per scene per model, model names stripped and shuffled, three blind raters
